EmailTemplate.name: Big 10 Challenge_AM to Sponsor Booked
EmailTemplate.subject: Is team spirit in your blood? Prove it.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <Sponsor Name>,
Donors at your American Red Cross blood drive on <blood drive date> can help fight against blood shortage while participating in the largest blood donation competition of our lifetime - “The We Give Blood Drive,” sponsored by Abbott and the Big Ten Conference®. Tap into the love and competitiveness of college football and energize fans to donate blood to support their school. We’re calling on all students, alumni and fans to show their school spirit by donating at your upcoming American Red Cross blood drive. Help rebuild the nation’s blood supply by pitting school against school in a conference-wide blood donation competition.
“The We Give Blood Drive” runs from September 26 – December 6, 2024. Donors at your upcoming blood drive will have a chance to win tickets to the 2024 Discover® Big Ten® Football Championship Game on December 7, 2024, while also helping your school have a chance to win $1 million to advance student or community health.*
Participate with these three easy steps:
1. Visit redcrossblood.org/give to schedule your Red Cross blood donation appointment – Sponsor Code XXXXXX
2. Submit proof of donation on behalf of your school at www.bigten.org/abbott/submit - include a selfie of donation experience
3. Stand by as the winner of the tickets will be announced, and tune in to the Discover® Big Ten® Football Championship Game on December 7 to see if your school won the $1 million grand prize*
To learn more, visit www.bigten.org/abbott/cause.
*This offer and any resulting prize during the competition are non-transferable and not redeemable for cash. Visit https://bigten.votigo.com/fbsweeps/pages/BigTenWeGiveBloodSweepstakes/rules for the terms and conditions of the sweepstakes.
